Counting only Presence destroyed in that land by this one addition, how many disks does each Spirit lose? new_complete_claim.topic: Q116 retains two fully graded branches. Given one simultaneous addition of two Blight to the stated land, each of the two Spirits loses one Presence there. Given two separate completed one-Blight additions, each loses Presence twice, totaling two disks per Spirit if still present. The simultaneous two-Blight producer is unverified in the assigned original core and receives zero current-base novelty credit; merely stipulating it does not verify it. The separate-additions branch is original-core supported, for example through a legal Powerstorm Repeat of Poisoned Land. Neither a cascade nor two separate uses proves simultaneity. Preserve all current question values, conditions, answer facts and regression grading.
